titulo: Revisão com referência facial dos intérpretes
regra: Filmes de Peter Jackson (O Senhor dos Anéis e O Hobbit) têm prioridade; Os Anéis de Poder só para personagens ausentes dos filmes.

geracao.metodo: FLUX.2 klein 9B com a imagem de referência como ReferenceLatent

personagens.prompt: Create a new square photographic head-and-shoulders portrait of the fictional character shown in image 1, for OpenArda's Tolkien character encyclopedia. Preserve the recognizable face, hair, beard and makeup of Ken Stott as Balin in The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey (2012). Calm neutral expression, natural skin texture, soft neutral window light with a subtle warm rim, simple muted warm charcoal-brown blurred background, costume visible at the shoulders. Frame the whole head centrally with margin for a circular crop; face large enough for a 36-pixel avatar. Exactly one person; leave out any weapons, other people and the background of image 1. No text, letters or watermark.
